title: Best Checking Account 2026: 5 Compared on Fees & APY
description: Schwab Bank, Ally Bank, Chase Total, SoFi, and Wells Fargo — checking accounts compared. Monthly fees, ATM access, APY, and which account for which user.
lede: Five checking accounts. We compared monthly fees, ATM access, APY, and integration with brokerage/credit card products.
methodology: Compared monthly fees, fee waivers, ATM access (US and international), interest rate (APY), and integration with other financial products from the same institution.

sections.heading: Online banks vs. traditional banks
paragraphs: Online banks (Ally, SoFi, Schwab): no monthly fees, higher APY (0.10-4.20%), no physical branches but Zelle/online tools.
Traditional banks (Chase, Wells Fargo): physical branches, in-person services, but $10-12 monthly fees (waivable with deposits/balances).

sections.heading: Best for each use
paragraphs: Best for travelers: Schwab Bank. Unlimited ATM rebates worldwide, no foreign transaction fees.
Best online bank: Ally Bank. 0.10-0.25% APY, $0 monthly fee, 43K+ ATMs free.
Best big bank relationship: Chase Total Checking. 4,700+ branches, large ATM network.
Best combined: SoFi. Up to 4.20% APY on savings, $0 fees.
Best for Wells customers: Wells Fargo Everyday. 4,700+ branches.

faqs.q: Should I have multiple checking accounts?
faqs.a: Yes for many — primary checking + travel checking (Schwab) + online savings (Ally/SoFi). Maximize different features without paying fees.
Yes — FDIC-insured up to $250K, same as traditional banks. Online banks have lower overhead, which is why they offer better rates.

faqs.q: How important is APY on checking?
faqs.a: Marginally — checking is for liquidity, not yield. Keep $2-4K in checking, the rest in high-yield savings. APY on checking matters less than on savings.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Zelle and Venmo?
faqs.a: Zelle is bank-to-bank (no separate account needed, free). Venmo is a separate account (faster between Venmo users but slower to bank). Most major banks support Zelle.

schwab-bank-checking.review: Schwab Bank Investor Checking is the right pick for international travelers. No monthly fees, unlimited ATM rebates worldwide (use any ATM anywhere, Schwab refunds the fee at end of month), no foreign transaction fees on debit card. Best travel checking account in the US.
cons: Requires Schwab brokerage account to open

ally-bank-checking.review: Ally Bank Interest Checking is the right online bank checking. 0.10-0.25% APY, $0 monthly fee, 43,000+ free ATMs (AllPoint network), free ATM rebates up to $10/month outside network. Solid online bank with strong mobile app.
cons: ATM rebate limited to $10/month outside network

chase-total-checking.review: Chase Total Checking is the right pick if you value in-person banking. 4,700+ branches, 16,000+ ATMs, $200-300 sign-up bonus (when offered). Monthly fee $12, waived with $500 direct deposit or $1,500 balance. Best big bank relationship for credit card/mortgage integration.

sofi-checking.review: SoFi Checking and Savings is the right pick if you want one product to do both. Up to 4.20% APY on savings portion, $0 monthly fees, combined checking + savings. SoFi member benefits apply across their products (loans, investing, etc.).

wells-fargo-everyday-checking.review: Wells Fargo Everyday Checking is the right pick if you're already a Wells Fargo customer. 4,700+ branches, broad ATM network. Monthly fee $10, waivable with direct deposit or $500 balance. Comparable to Chase but with Wells' specific perks (online tools, credit cards).

offerNotes.schwab-bank-checking: Open at schwab.com. Requires linked Schwab brokerage account (which is also $0 minimum).
offerNotes.ally-bank-checking: Open at ally.com. Online-only — no branches.
offerNotes.chase-total-checking: Open at chase.com or in-branch. Sign-up bonuses (when offered) require qualifying activities.
offerNotes.sofi-checking: Open at sofi.com. SoFi member benefits apply across other SoFi products.

recommendedFor.label: Frequent international travelers who use foreign ATMs
recommendedFor.reason: Schwab refunds every ATM fee worldwide at month-end and charges zero foreign transaction fees on the debit card.

recommendedFor.label: Remote workers who prefer managing finances fully online
recommendedFor.reason: Ally's $0 monthly fee, 0.25% APY, and 43,000+ free ATMs deliver full-featured banking without ever visiting a branch.

recommendedFor.label: Young professionals building a first credit card relationship
recommendedFor.reason: Chase's 4,700+ branches and regular $200-300 sign-up bonuses make it easy to bundle a Chase credit card under one login.

recommendedFor.label: Savers who want checking and high-yield savings in one app
recommendedFor.reason: SoFi's combined account earns up to 4.20% APY on the savings portion with $0 fees and unified member benefits for loans and investing.

recommendedFor.label: Existing Wells Fargo mortgage or credit card holders
recommendedFor.reason: Wells Fargo's 4,700+ branches and integrated online tools let existing customers consolidate banking, credit, and mortgage in one place.
